visual_appeal: Reduce the hero portrait from approximately 112px to 96px and give its metadata another 12px of horizontal breathing room. The portrait, speech box, long metadata line and large banked figure currently compete rather than form a clean hierarchy.

Keep the large hero progress bar, but reduce roster bars to an 11–12px height and soften their internal segment lines. Six repeated bright, segmented bars make the lower half feel more mechanical than the character-led hero.
Use one consistent 1px inner separator treatment. The combination of bright gold rules, state rails, panel borders and bar outlines produces too many competing edges.
state_colours: Do not draw the not-resting timeline lane as a solid red bar extending all the way to +48h with an arrow. It visually promises progression despite the correct explanatory text. Use a 2px dashed red baseline with a stop marker at NOW and retain the not-filling message in the date column.

Keep the four established hues, but darken the RESTING chip fill to approximately #603000 while retaining an orange border and pale orange label. Its current saturated orange-brown block is disproportionately prominent beside the short orange progress bars.
Make FULL, NEARLY FULL and NOT RESTING icons share a consistent 10–12px visual size; the nearly-full arrow currently reads more like a tiny decorative star than a meaningful status indicator.
character_identity: On the character card, move the speech bubble down approximately 24px and point its tail toward the portrait. It currently points into empty space above the character, weakening the impression that this character is speaking.
Remove the repeated character name from the card's title bar, or replace it with Character details. Keep the large class-coloured name in the content as the identity anchor.

Increase roster main portraits to 44px while retaining 16–18px race/gender badges. The settled class-icon approach is sound, but the present small images make several characters read primarily as repeated spell icons.
default_theme: Reduce the default hero portrait's heavy gold surround to a 2px bronze rim plus the state-coloured edge. It currently looks like a separate premium widget pasted onto the thinner surrounding frame.

Use a subtler alternating-row difference, approximately #2A2116 and #302619, and reduce row separator contrast. The current stacked brown panels are competent but still feel like a dense utility table.
Give the secondary buttons a consistent dark bronze fill and a 1px #806338 border. Match their label padding and heights across Compact, View details, Unlink and All accounts.
elvui_wc3_fit: Preserve runtime ElvUI colour, font and texture inheritance. Refine the addon-owned spacing instead: use consistent 12px content insets and match the reference Character window's restrained inner section divisions.

The default and ElvUI renders currently retain almost the same gold-heavy information styling. In ElvUI mode, use the inherited neutral border for roster separators and reserve gold for headings, selection and actions.
Reduce the height of the empty decorative header area above the hero by about 10px. The reference windows feel more tightly attached to their functional content.
alerts_ux: Rewrite the logout heading to Rest at an inn before logging out. Cancel logout is an imperative presented as text rather than an actual cancel control; do not imply that the addon can stop the logout unless it provides that action.
Give every dismiss control a minimum 22×22px hit area with 6px separation from nearby controls. The banner's gear and close controls are visibly cramped.

For the rested-XP-used-up toast, make the exhausted character the 14px primary heading and the replacement recommendation the second line. The current small cause line is visually subordinate to the destination.

In move mode, add a persistent 1px dashed inner outline and a short Drag to move label to every placeholder, including To最asts, so the draggable surface is equally explicit across all three notification types.
readability: Increase roster metadata and fill-time text to at least 13px at the rendered scale. Increase small uppercase section labels to 11–12px and avoid relying on heavy outlining to compensate for small size.

Provide the promised calendar timestamp in the main roster, not only in the compact tooltip and character card. Use two lines below each bar: Full in 7d 21h, then Wed 2 Dec, 01:36 in muted cream; increase row height to approximately 66px if necessary.

Reserve at least 210px for character metadata and truncate only the location, not the class or last-seen value. Current examples such as Thunderbrew... and Dun Morogh ·... are difficult to scan consistently.
Change the options account label #3 to Account 3. Shorten the long ElvUI frame checkbox label and place its reload qualification in a tooltip.
Widen the timeline's right-hand date column to at least 112px. The red not-filling message currently runs into the panel's right edge.
layout_polish: Add 10–12px between More rest is wasted and the plan strip. In both main-window renders, that line sits almost directly on the divider.
Align roster names, metadata baselines, progress bars and chips to a fixed column grid. Give every chip the same 116px width and 20px height, vertically centred within its row.
Allocate the timeline tooltip a clear overlay position that avoids covering multiple lane endpoints and dates. Anchor it above the hovered lane where space permits, with an 8px gap from the marker.

Increase spacing between the options notification helper text and WINDOW AND DISPLAY by 8px. Recover the space by shortening the About copy or placing attribution behind an About link rather than compressing the settings groups.
delight: Keep the character-specific speech, but attach the bubble convincingly to its speaker and use the same padding and tail geometry in the hero and character card.
Render the sleeping Z marks in a restrained #C6BEAA and keep them within 12px of the portrait rim. The current bright marks float independently of the portrait.
Make the runner-up line more conversational and exact: Then Le Bankken · full in 19h 11m. Its rounded 19h currently feels less considered beside the precise time elsewhere.

overall_notes: A substantial improvement over the real baseline: the recommendation is unmistakable, the numbered handoff is useful, and the corrected not-filling copy removes a serious semantic error. The inherited ElvUI surfaces also sit much closer to the supplied references. This is a strong addon UI, but not yet a demanding-user approval at 9+: cramped hero spacing, undersized supporting text, incomplete main-roster timestamps and the misleading red timeline geometry remain visible product-level issues. The character card has personality, but its speech composition needs another pass. No deduction is made for simulator model placeholders, class-coloured names, the four state hues, or the settled portrait and badge rules.
